note: Sites ring a central recreation field in Salt Rock State Forest near Baltic, with the Shetucket River beyond the railroad to the west. Many sites are short: only full-hookup sites 2-7, water-and-electric sites 47-51 and no-hookup sites 67-69 are posted at 35 ft; most others are 16-20 ft. Two pets per site. --Claude
